description: Stop your assistant using stale APIs: the latest docs for any npm, PyPI, crates or Go library, trimmed to your topic. ★ One of our best tools. Up-to-date docs for any npm, PyPI, crates or Go library, trimmed for a coding agent's context: finds the project's own llms.txt and docs pages (or the latest release's README), keeps the sections relevant to your topic, within a token budget, with sources and the current version. Stops agents using stale APIs. Price: $0.005 in USDC per call (x402 or prepaid credits). In the free trial.

ecosystem.description: Package ecosystem: npm, pypi, crates (Rust) or go (Go modules).

library.description: Library/package name as published, e.g. hono, fastapi, serde, github.com/gin-gonic/gin.

tokens.description: Most tokens of documentation to return.

topic.description: What you need, e.g. routing, authentication, streaming responses (default: overview).

name: docs-lib

content.description: Markdown documentation, each part headed by an HTML comment naming its source.

truncated.description: True if relevant material was left out to fit the budget.

version.description: Latest published version the docs were matched to.

title: Current docs for any library ($0.005)
